target.title: fix(google): normalize legacy provider config with api + cost.cacheWrite compat migration
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #102138 — legacy Google provider config blocks (generated by older `openclaw onboard`/setup) silently become unavailable because the current model-catalog schema requires `api` and `cost.cacheWrite` fields that the old setup never wrote.

**Impact**: All `google/*` models disappear from the catalog ("not allowed"), and any fallback chain that selects them results in a 120s LLM idle timeout instead of failing fast.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Google extension doctor contract did not export `normalizeCompatibilityConfig`, so `openclaw doctor --fix` could not repair stale provider blocks. This follows the established pattern used by `extensions/ollama`, `extensions/elevenlabs`, and others.

## What Changed

- **`extensions/google/doctor-contract-api.ts`** — re-exports `normalizeCompatibilityConfig` from `./src/config-compat.js`
- **`extensions/google/src/config-compat.ts`** (new) — backfills missing `provider.api` (`google-generative-ai` or `google-vertex`) and `cost.cacheWrite: 0` for google/google-vertex/google-antigravity/google-gemini-cli providers. Idempotent: preserves already-correct configs.
- **`extensions/google/src/config-compat.test.ts`** (new) — 13 unit tests covering all provider IDs, idempotency, non-Google passthrough, edge cases.

## Evidence

### Post-fix verification — 13/13 tests pass
```
✓ sets missing api to google-generative-ai for google provider
✓ sets missing api to google-vertex for google-vertex provider
✓ sets missing api to google-generative-ai for google-antigravity provider
✓ sets missing api to google-generative-ai for google-gemini-cli provider
✓ preserves existing api when already set
✓ preserves non-Google providers untouched
✓ adds missing cacheWrite to model cost
✓ preserves model cost when cacheWrite already present
✓ skips models without cost objects
✓ fixes both api and cacheWrite in a single pass
✓ no changes when config has no providers
✓ no changes when models is absent
✓ handles models array with non-record entries
```

### Pre-fix behavior
Legacy Google provider config block — `provider.api` absent, `models[].cost` has `{input, output, cacheRead}` without `cacheWrite` → catalog load fails silently → all `google/*` models become "not allowed" → fallback chain hits 120s LLM idle timeout.

### Post-fix result
`openclaw doctor --fix` auto-discovers the migration via the contract registry and backfills `api: "google-generative-ai"` (or `"google-vertex"`) and `cost.cacheWrite: 0`. Models load into the catalog correctly after migration.

### Local checks
- `git diff --check` — clean, no whitespace issues
- `npx oxfmt --check` — all files correctly formatted
- `npx vitest run extensions/google/src/config-compat.test.ts` — **13/13 passed**
